benchmark: S8 capacity-aging model: Arrhenius+SOC+sqrt(t) calendar and throughput cycle, separable regression, conditional valid domain (no BLAST-Lite dependency)
parameter_provenance: TEACHING-SYNTHETIC: hand-chosen demo constants, NOT fitted to any real cell. Synthetic data validates algorithm semantics, not calibration.

calendar_monotonic_T.note: Calendar loss strictly increases with temperature (Arrhenius) at fixed SOC,t.

calendar_monotonic_SOC.note: Calendar loss strictly increases with SOC stress at fixed T,t.

calendar_monotonic_time.note: Calendar loss strictly increases with elapsed time (sqrt(t)).

cycle_linear_throughput.note: Cycle loss proportional to |I|/Q throughput, zero intercept.

separable_parameter_recovery.note: Calendar and cycle params each recovered from synthetic truth within 1%.

separable_regression_residual.note: Reconstructed two-component SOH matches noisy synthetic observations with <1% residual.

domain_interpolation_small.note: Inside training window bilinear interpolation matches analytic rate factor within 1%.

extrapolation_flagged_no_accuracy.note: Outside (60C,1.00 SOC) flagged extrapolation=True; NO accuracy claim is made.

fixed_seed_reproducible.note: default_rng(SEED) gives bit-identical recovered params across runs.

value.note: Fixed-energy control fixes cycle loss (throughput only); fixed-SOC-window control changes wall time so calendar loss differs. Cycle loss never depends on time-splitting.

control_assumption_semantics.note: Fixed-energy throughput vs fixed-SOC-window assumptions distinguished; cycle loss is time-split-invariant.

extrapolation_limit.registered_as: extrapolation-limit evidence: domain boundary only, no precision claim

r03_empirical_status.note: No external aging data; synthetic benchmark cannot close R03 empirical validation. Expected-life is qualitative only.
